problem_statement: Build a brand-new /resources page from scratch on the Accessible Astro Starter theme. The route /resources does not exist yet (baseline renders an empty stub). Create src/pages/resources.astro as an 'accessibility resource hub' that reuses the site's design system — the DefaultLayout shell (shared Header nav + Footer), the PageHeader hero with a neutral background, the brand colour tokens (--brand-primary etc.), the Heading/Tabs/Notification/Link components from the accessible-astro-components package, and the container/spacing utilities. The page groups curated links into three categories using the shared Tabs component: Guidelines (WCAG 2.2, WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices, Inclusive Design Principles), Tooling (axe DevTools, Lighthouse, Screen readers) and Learning (The A11Y Project, Deque University, MDN Accessibility). Each category is a tab whose panel lists three items (h3 name + one-line summary). Guidelines is the default-active tab; clicking the 'Tooling' tab must reveal the Tooling panel (axe DevTools etc.). Close with an info Notification callout and a rounded primary CTA 'View accessible components' -> /accessible-components. Cross-page consistency: the new page must visually and structurally match the sibling pages (color-contrast-checker, accessible-launcher) — same nav/header/footer chrome and theme tokens. Static data inlined in the page (no network fetch).
required_content: A PageHeader hero (reused component, bgType='neutral') with an h1 'Resources' and a subtitle describing a curated hub of guidelines, tooling and learning material.
An intro section: an h2 'Curated for accessible builds' plus a prose paragraph (text-2xl) explaining the three categories and the design-system reuse.

A Tabs component (from accessible-astro-components) with three tabs labelled Guidelines, Tooling and Learning; the Guidelines tab is selected by default. Each tab button carries a data-tab attribute (guidelines/tooling/learning).

Guidelines panel (default-active): an h3 'Guidelines' heading + blurb, and three resource items each an h3 name + one-line summary — WCAG 2.2, WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices, Inclusive Design Principles.
Tooling panel (revealed by clicking the Tooling tab): an h3 'Tooling' heading + blurb, and three items — axe DevTools, Lighthouse, Screen readers.
Learning panel: an h3 'Learning' heading + blurb, and three items — The A11Y Project, Deque University, MDN Accessibility.

A closing info Notification callout (accent variant) guiding newcomers, and an h2 'Keep exploring' section with a rounded primary CTA anchor 'View accessible components' linking to /accessible-components.
design_constraints: Reuse DefaultLayout (shared Header nav + Footer) — do not hand-roll the site chrome; the page must be structurally consistent with sibling pages.
Reuse PageHeader for the hero (bgType='neutral'), matching color-contrast-checker / accessible-launcher.
Reuse the accessible-astro-components package components: Heading, Tabs/TabsList/TabsTab/TabsPanel, Notification, Link (isButton type='primary').
Use the existing brand colour tokens (--brand-primary / --color-* palette) and container/space-content spacing utilities — no new fonts or off-palette colours.
Inline the resource data as a static array in the page frontmatter — no live API / network fetch.

Typography + palette (from the shared design system, must match siblings): use the site font 'Atkinson Hyperlegible' (no new fonts); keep a light neutral page background (near-white #ffffff with light-grey #d9dfe5 / #8f9194 borders and surfaces); use the brand primary accent token (--brand-primary, a vivid magenta-purple, oklch hue ~317) for the active tab indicator and the rounded primary CTA. Do not introduce off-palette colours.
author_notes: 方案A: baseline src/pages/resources.astro = bare empty-body stub (no DefaultLayout/nav/footer -> check A empty; SSG needs an explicit empty page file per #18k so the absent route doesn't fall back to home). reference = full page reusing DefaultLayout/PageHeader/Tabs/Notification/Link + 3 category tabs (9 items) + CTA, Guidelines default-active. bad = reference with the Tabs panel id changed from 'resources-panel-<id>' to 'resources-pane-<id>' so the tab button's aria-controls no longer matches any panel id -> clicking the Tooling tab reveals NOTHING (the display:none Tooling panel never un-hides) -> interaction_assertions FAILS ONLY (axe DevTools h3 never becomes visible after click); all other gates (dom/consistency/overflow/console/visual) still pass because the static page + shared chrome are otherwise identical. T3 differentiator = cross-page consistency (shared DefaultLayout nav/header/footer + brand tokens match siblings) + the Tabs interaction. 三份工作区源码 md5 互不相同.
